QUOTE: Config-gated. Everything sits under `MBEDTLS_ERROR_C`. With it off, `mbedtls_strerror` is a stub that writes an empty string (`error.c:144`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the strings are gated by MBEDTLS_ERROR_C but never states it is enabled in the shipped config, so a default build has the table.
